_comment: Trend Scan coherence links (editorial physical reasoning). expected_sign = +1 means the two trends are expected to have the same sign, -1 opposite. Used ONLY to flag consistency, never to claim causation.

links.why: Less rain usually means drier soil.
Drier soil usually limits plant growth in water-limited regions.
In water-limited regions greenness follows rainfall.
Vegetation cools the surface through transpiration; browning often warms it.
Warmer air and warmer surface usually go together.
Warmer air can hold more water vapour.
Evapotranspiration is limited by soil water in dry regions.
